principals.name: Initiator
principals.description: IKEv2 initiator. Opens IKE_SA_INIT with its DH share and nonce, derives the SKEYSEED tree, then authenticates in IKE_AUTH by signing the IKE_SA_INIT request transcript with its own signature key, and proposes the Child SA.

principals.name: Responder
principals.description: IKEv2 responder. Answers IKE_SA_INIT with its own DH share and nonce, verifies the initiator's AUTH signature against the peer public key, signs the IKE_SA_INIT response transcript in return, and answers with its own Child SA selection.

values.name: sk_Initiator
values.description: The initiator's long-term private signature key.

values.name: pk_Initiator
values.description: The initiator's public signature-verification key, computed from sk_Initiator. The document lets it reach the responder as a certificate in the CERT payload of IKE_AUTH (validated against the responder's trust anchors) or be configured locally as authentication data for the initiator's identity, so the responder is not assumed to store it beforehand.

values.name: sk_Responder
values.description: The responder's long-term private signature key.

values.name: pk_Responder
values.description: The responder's public signature-verification key, computed from sk_Responder. The document lets it reach the initiator as a certificate in the CERT payload of IKE_AUTH (validated against the initiator's trust anchors) or be configured locally as authentication data for the responder's identity, so the initiator is not assumed to store it beforehand.

values.name: IDi
values.description: The initiator's own identity, asserted in the IDi payload of IKE_AUTH; the responder learns it there and uses it to look up its policy and authentication data.

values.name: IDr
values.description: The responder's own identity, asserted in the IDr payload of IKE_AUTH; the initiator may name the identity it wants to talk to, but which peer it talks to is a seating choice.

values.name: SAi1
values.description: The cryptographic suites the initiator supports for the IKE SA, offered in IKE_SA_INIT.

values.name: SAi2
values.description: The Child SA proposals the initiator supports, offered in IKE_AUTH.

values.name: TSi
values.description: The initiator-side traffic selectors the initiator proposes, taken from its own Security Policy Database; the responder receives them in IKE_AUTH and narrows them by its own policy.

values.name: TSr
values.description: The responder-side traffic selectors the initiator proposes, taken from its own Security Policy Database; the responder receives them in IKE_AUTH and narrows them by its own policy.
